name: Monykah the Greedy
source:
"Time is money."

Rich and selfish, she owns the biggest bank in hell, the "MEGA INTEREST" bank. She eats, drinks and breathes wealth, and will not talk to you unless you're willing to contribute to her lifestyle. Are you prepared to make a deal with a dragon?
